post.summary: Validates that the site and warehouse both exist, then links the warehouse to the site and updates its role assignments.
Generates a unique alphanumeric site code derived from the site name (if site codes are enabled) and persists it on the project site, after validation.
Creates a new site document record linked to a project site, after validation.
Bulk-creates new site structure records for a site after validation, queuing a background grouping-management task for each created structure.
Creates a new warehouse for a site after validation, links it back to the site, and auto-creates its default equipment (a trolley and a forklift).
Soft-deletes a material by marking it for deletion rather than removing the record.
Deletes a site structure record and queues a background task to clean up its related structure grouping.
Deactivates any currently active CLM global notification and, if activating, saves a new one, then broadcasts the active/inactive status and message in real time, after validation.
Creates a material document record for the upload after validation, then queues a background task to bulk create/update the actual material records from the parsed file data.

Saves the user's Excel-column-to-field header mapping for an uploaded material file, after validation, computes/validates the resulting rows against existing teams/materials, and sends a notification indicating success or failure.
Creates or updates one or more site instructions for a site after validation, matching existing entries by id.
Validates each submitted domain against restricted keywords/characters and persists only the accepted domains to the site's whitelist, returning the accepted and rejected domain lists.
Persists a landing-page contact submission (anonymous endpoint, no authorization required) after validation, then sends a templated email to the configured default wiki admin address.
Updates an organization's fields after validation, then cascades a changed organization name to all related persons and team members.
Updates a site's contact person name, email, and phone fields after validation.
Updates a site's notice text and enabled flag after validation, then queues a background task to clean up stale user notice-dismissal settings.

Updates a site structure after validation and queues background tasks to reconcile the change (cascading renamed building/floor/laydown names across shipments, equipment bookings, timelines, and material handovers) and to update grouping.
Updates a warehouse's fields (address, contact, dates, image, etc.) after validation; if the address changed, queues a background task to update shipment PDF footers referencing it.

Downloads and parses an uploaded material Excel file into a temporary upload record (matching column headers via translation lookups), after validation, and sends a real-time notification indicating processing success or failure.

Creates or updates site instructions flagged specifically for Konshub after validation (same handler as M:Clm.Construction.WebService.Controllers.CommandControllers.ConstructionManagementCommandController.SaveSiteInstructions(ConstructionManagement.Commands.SiteInstructionsSaveCommand), routed to the Konshub instruction records).

Creates or updates a material after validation. On create, resolves the material unit and sets up vendor/read-write role permissions; on update, queues a background task to propagate the changed name/unit/dimensions into referencing shipments and trigger their PDF regeneration.

Creates or updates a construction project after validation (assigning managers/theme on create), then queues a background task for role/permission setup and, on create, another to build project teams from the assigned managers.

Creates or updates a project site after validation. On create, generates a site code (if enabled) and queues site-manager/planner team creation; on update, propagates name/address changes into related shipment records (triggering PDF regeneration) and sends an in-app notification. Also queues a background task for role/permission propagation.
Parses an uploaded Excel file into site structure/laydown data after validation, then rebuilds the site's entire structure hierarchy (replacing existing records) and stores the source file reference.

Checks whether the current user has Konshub access based on warehouse assignment — Admins get access if any (or the specified) site has a warehouse; other users are checked via their team assignments.

get.summary: Resolves the appropriate sample material upload template (vendor vs. non-vendor, per language) from a static mapping and downloads it via the storage service.

post.summary: Retrieves the currently active CLM global notification, or a default (inactive) model if none is configured.
Retrieves paginated organizations along with, for each, the count of assigned team members and their resolved project sites.
Builds an Excel export of a site's structure (ordered by name, with localized column headers) and returns the generated file's download id.
Retrieves a single file by its id along with its linked thumbnail files.
Retrieves files by id along with their linked thumbnail files, grouped per parent file.
Retrieves the non-deleted Konshub-specific site instructions for a site.
Retrieves a single material by its item id, after validation.
Retrieves the parsed temporary material rows for an uploaded file (faulty rows first), plus active material units and the teams the caller (vendor or otherwise) may assign materials to.
Retrieves the processed column headers for an uploaded material file once processing has completed; for vendor uploaders it also resolves their assigned teams.
Retrieves a paginated, searchable list of materials for a site (searchable by name, unit, description, team, and shipment counts), with role-based filtering applied.
Retrieves a material by id and computes its shipment usage totals, grouped by status (open, approved, completed).
Retrieves a project's detail, resolving its managers/planners (via team member role assignments), role-filtered project sites, and image thumbnails for the project and its managers/planners.
Retrieves a project by id along with its project sites and project image thumbnail, mapped into an edit-detail model.
Retrieves a project site by id along with its parent project and site image, mapped into an edit-detail model, after validation.

get.summary: Retrieves the projects behind the current user's pending team-join requests, excluding projects the user is already assigned to, ordered by name.
Retrieves a site's zones as locations, optionally filtering out unloading zones that are inactive per calendar reservations against a given date, each enriched with direction way-points.

post.summary: Retrieves a site's overview (image, site managers, unloading zones) together with active calendar reservations for those zones, filtering out expired ones.
Retrieves a paginated, searchable list of site structure groupings for a site.
Retrieves all site structure records for a site and assembles them into a hierarchical structure response (buildings/floors/laydowns).

get.summary: Retrieves a zone by id along with its equipment, direction way-points, and (depending on its location type) related waiting areas or unloading zones that reference it.
Retrieves zones belonging to a site or shared at the project level (optionally filtered to only active ones), each enriched with its direction way-points.

post.summary: Creates or updates a mobile app version record for a given OS after validation; if marked as the latest version, unmarks any other non-deleted version for that OS as latest.
Creates or updates the single CLM mobile maintenance record, toggling app-wide maintenance mode for the mobile app on or off.
Compares the client's app version against the latest mobile version for its OS and returns the required update type (none, optional, or forced) along with release notes.

get.summary: Retrieves the current CLM mobile maintenance record, defaulting to maintenance-off if none has been configured yet.

post.summary: Retrieves mobile app versions for a given OS type that were updated on or after a specified date.
TestHost api
Creates a new wiki file attachment record after validation.
Deletes a wiki page and its content after validation, then recalculates whether the parent page still has children.
Deletes a wiki FAQ after validation and renumbers the sort order of the remaining FAQs sequentially.
Deletes a wiki file attachment record after validation.
Clears a wiki page's content after validation — resets its content/draft/file-info fields to empty and marks it as having no content.
Deletes a wiki release note by its id, after validation.
Persists a wiki popup/contact submission and sends a notification email to the configured default wiki admin address, after validation.
Reassigns the sort order of all wiki FAQs to match the provided ordered ID list, appending any unlisted FAQs after, following validation.

Updates a wiki page's content after validation: if published, writes to the live content/file-info (clearing draft data) and marks the page as having content; otherwise saves to the draft content/file-info and marks it as a draft.
Reassigns the sort order of a set of sibling wiki pages under a parent to match the given ordered list, after validation.
Updates an existing wiki file attachment's fields after validation; if the file URL changed, queues a background task to rewrite old URL references elsewhere.

Reparents a wiki page under a new parent after validation, cascading the new parent's sites/roles/languages down to it and all its descendant pages, and updates the has-children flag on both the old and new parents.
Creates a new wiki page (with an empty content record, added as a child of the parent) or updates an existing page's title/roles/sites/languages/public flag, after validation.
Creates a new wiki FAQ (appended to the end of the sort order) or updates an existing one's fields, after validation.
Creates a new wiki release note or updates an existing one depending on whether its id already exists, after validation.
Checks whether a proposed wiki file name already exists on another file (excluding the file being edited, if any).
Admin-only bulk export: retrieves all non-deleted wiki pages merged with their content; returns an empty list for non-Admin callers.
Retrieves a wiki page's content only if the page is flagged as public (no authorization required); returns null/empty otherwise.
Retrieves wiki FAQ entries, optionally restricted to a supplied set of FAQ ids, ordered by sort order.
Retrieves paginated, filtered/sorted wiki file attachments (filterable by file type and search text), enriched with thumbnail URLs from the storage service.
Retrieves a wiki page's content, enriched with its applicable sites/roles (inherited from the nearest ancestor page if the page itself doesn't define its own).
Retrieves a single wiki page's details by its page id.
Retrieves the child wiki pages under a given parent page, restricted to those the caller's site/role assignments grant access to (Admins/SuperAdmins see all), ordered by sort order.
Retrieves the languages applicable to a wiki page: its own configured languages if set, otherwise all supported languages (flagged as "all languages").
Retrieves the roles applicable to a wiki page: its own configured roles if set, otherwise all wiki roles (flagged as "all roles").
Retrieves the active project sites applicable to a wiki page: its own configured (non-deleted, not-yet-ended) sites if set, otherwise all active project sites.
Retrieves wiki release notes, optionally restricted to a supplied set of ids, ordered by release date descending.
Creates a new zone (with its direction way-points) after validation; if it's an unloading zone, queues a background task to complete its setup.
Deletes unloading-point (UP) edges for a site, optionally filtered to specific source and/or destination unloading points.

Deletes a zone along with its direction way-points and unloading-point edges (removing it from any unloading zone's entry-point list if it was an entry point), then queues a background task to purge it from future booking-prerequisite records.
Overwrites the list of equipment mapped to a zone.
Overwrites the list of vehicles mapped to a zone.
Builds and saves a new unloading-point (UP) edge describing a source/destination relationship between two zones.
Bulk-updates the location address on one or more zones; for entry-point zones, also propagates the new address into the embedded entry-point list of any unloading zone that references it.

Updates a zone's fields and replaces its direction way-points after validation, clears stale shipment report data for the zone, and queues a background task (specific to unloading zone, waiting area, or entry point) to propagate the change to shipments, booking prerequisites, equipment timelines, and map data.

Regenerates/updates the zone's booking-prerequisite documents for the given date range based on its reservation-object availability, after validation, and clears stale reservations falling outside the new window.
Checks whether another zone on the same site (excluding the zone being edited) already has the same id-name or name (case-insensitive).
Determines whether "smart flow" is enabled for a site by checking whether any unloading-point edge exists for it.
Retrieves all unloading-point (UP) edges for a site plus their referenced source/destination zones, combined with site info describing the site's unloading-point flow graph.
Retrieves unloading zones whose entry-point list contains the given entry point id.
